description: T-2490: IPMT and PPMT at huge rates and where (1+rate)^nper leaves the double range: a grid over rate (0.5 to 1E+300), nper (10 to 2000), period (2, nper/2, nper), pv/fv (fv 0, pv 0, both, pv+fv 0) and type in column A; in column B type-1 period 1 with an underflowing P, PPMT near the subnormal discount boundary (rate 10, nper 296-310), overflowing (pv+fv)*rate, pv 0 with fv across terms and pv 1E+300.
